...Yes. This was not Enoshima.

This was Katase, on the shore facing it. Staying here would get us nowhere, and I understood perfectly why Ichijou wished to cross at once.

But we were staying, and a man who stays should have reasons. I had several. I gave her the most direct one first.

en.html:
Kageaki"We cannot cross."
Ichijou"...Huh? Why not?"
Kageaki"I investigated on the way here. At present the whole of Enoshima is designated a no-entry zone."
Kageaki"The order came from the shogunate. Reason unknown."
Kanae"Weapons research as reported, and this would be the natural precaution. Of course, one cannot pronounce the verdict on that alone..."
Sayo"That the suspicion has grown stronger is a fact. Pray do not lower your guard, not even for a moment."
Ichijou"So... what do we do?"
Kageaki"If crossing openly is impossible, we cross not-openly. That is all. Finding the method is the second reason we are staying here."
Kageaki"The third is information gathering. Ordinarily I dislike asking around right before the objective. It is a roundabout way."
Sayo"On this occasion, the abnormality of the destination is already plain for all to see."
Kageaki"Ji."
Ichijou"...Yeah, that's true. Before we go to the island we should at least know a little about what this situation even is..."
Kanae"To walk onto that island knowing nothing would make anyone think twice. ...Also, it is summer."
Kageaki"It is summer."
Sayo"It is summer, certainly."
Ichijou"Summer. It really is..."

Sayo"It is summer, certainly."

Ichijou"Summer. It really is..."

en.html:
Sayo"Come, Mr. Minato, the hour of decision has arrived!"
Kageaki"Rejected. I can find no effect other than a decline in investigative efficiency."
Kanae"There you are supposed to produce some wildly far-fetched excuse and justify yourself! A man should have at least that much initiative!"
Ichijou"Your brain—is it made of cancer or what?"
Sayo"Miss Ayane, your mouth is going too far!"
Kanae"Yes! What a cruel thing to say."
Sayo"Our mistress being seriously ill in the head is one fact. Put that fact aside, and her remark just now was very nearly, quite remarkably, the heart of the matter!"
Kanae"O hello. One moment, Chamberlain."
Ichijou"As if. What kind of man even does that?"
Sayo"No, no, Miss Ayane. A true leading man completes his appointed mission AND ends up with his love interest. Surely that is the whole point—"
Kanae"Kageaki! Suddenly, artistic inspiration! The title: Swimsuit and Rifle."
Kanae"An avant-garde play. Fifty years from now, some planner with no ideas left will probably think of it in desperation. Shall we begin now, here?"
Kageaki"Please do it somewhere with no connection to me."

さよ 「さあ、決断の時ですよ湊斗さま！」
景明 「却下致します。 　調査効率の悪化を招く以外に、効果が認め られません」
香奈枝 「そこで牽強付会なこじつけをして己の行動 を正当化するのが男の甲斐性というものです のに！」
一条 「おめー実は脳味噌が癌なんじゃねえの？」
さよ 「綾弥さまっ、口が過ぎますよ！」
香奈枝 「そうですっ。酷いことを」
さよ 「お嬢さまが頭を深刻に病んでおられるのは 事実でございますが、それはそれとして、今 のご発言はわりとけっこう核心を突いていた りするのです！」
香奈枝 「おいおい。待てよ侍従」
一条 「んなわけねーだろ……。 　そりゃ一体どんな男だ」
さよ 「いやいや綾弥さま。 　己に課せられた使命を果たしつつしっかり 恋人ヒロインと結ばれてこそ男児の本懐というもので ございまして――」
香奈枝 「景明さまっ、わたくし唐突に芸術的インス ピレェションを獲得しました！ 　題して水着とライフル銃」

景明 「自分と一切無関係の所でお願いします」
